# `desktop` operations

2 operations. Generated from `assets/operations.json`; [all references](index.md).

### desktop.status

Desktop status. read-only, idempotent.

Read recent jobs and live preview sessions for the desktop panel.

No arguments.

```sh
tomaccoctl call desktop.status
```

### desktop.open

Open Tomacco. writes, idempotent.

Show an existing desktop session or start one, opening the requested workspace tab.

- `tab` string (one of runtime, preview, project, devices, ios-research, jobs, tools, debug, testing, profiling, files, release; default "runtime")
- `session` string (matching `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,40}`; default "main"): Running preview session name; defaults to main
- `path` string: Project root to open
- `file` string: Project-relative source file to reveal in the files tab
- `line` integer (1 to 10000000; default 1)
- `device_only` boolean (default false): Start the desktop without showing its main window, for a detached device window. A desktop that is already running is left as it is.

```sh
tomaccoctl call desktop.open
```
